title: Aircover Pipeline — meetings.json (v1.0)
description: List of meetings pulled from /analytics for a date range, after applying optional --exclude-domains and --filter-emails filters.

deal_id.description: Of the form '<prospect-domain>/<deal-id>'. Empty string when the meeting has no linked Salesforce deal.

team_ids.description: Comma-separated list of Aircover team IDs the meeting is associated with. Empty string if none.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD calendar date of the meeting (from the meeting's ISO start timestamp).

notes_sent_to.description: Comma-separated list of attendee email addresses on the meeting's deal team. Empty string if none.
